text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's local currency interbank market has admitted seven foreign banks as second-tier members, allowing them to trade through short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank.
- Shanghai hopes to open off-shore finance trading on a trial basis, allowing foreign banks and companies in China to do financial transactions outside China through computerised systems.
- Both domestic and foreign brokerages are buying or renting office space in the Pudong New Area, heralding a quick expansion in financial business in the area.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Construction Minister Hou Jie says China intends to establish its first bank devoted to housing loans in Shanghai.
- Shanghai will shortly issue a set of rules governing the property market to promote the quick expansion of the sector.
- Commentary says Shanghai firms should be encouraged to acquire companies outside the city.
- WEN HUI BAO - researchers at the Shanghai Number Two Medical University succeeeds in growing a human ear on the body of a mouse.
